title: Self-Supervised Learning of Semantically Consistent Visual Features via a Simple 3D Prior
title_zh: 通过简单的三维先验实现语义一致视觉特征的自监督学习

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出了一种新的自监督学习方法，通过简单的三维先验实现语义一致的视觉特征学习。 Visual features extracted from vision models like DINOv2 or Stable Diffusion enable high quality semantic correspondence between images. However, such features exhibit documented limitations that hinder accurate correspondence estimation such as the inability to disambiguate the left from right for categories exhibiting symmetries or repeated parts. Previous attempts to improve these features rely on using supervised data such as annotated keypoint pairs or camera pose information, or make restrictive topological assumptions, such as modelling the object of interest as a 3D sphere. We introduce a new self-supervised approach that allows us to learn features for topologically complex object categories using a simple prior. Instead of relying on an expensive instance-level analysis by synthesis pipeline, our approach makes use of contrastive learning and distribution matching at the global dataset-level to learn the coarse shape and appearance of a category. Combined with additional geometric losses, this enables us to replicate the global and local statistics of visual features which match those that are extracted from real images. Quantitative results are presented across several challenging object categories, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出了一种新的自监督学习方法，通过简单的三维先验实现语义一致的视觉特征学习。从 DINOv2 或 Stable Diffusion 等视觉模型中提取的视觉特征能够确保图像之间具有高质量的语义对应关系。 然而，这类特征存在已知的局限性，会阻碍精确的对应关系估计，例如无法区分具有对称性或重复部分的类别中的左侧与右侧。 以往改进这些特征的尝试依赖于使用监督数据（如带标注的关键点配对或相机姿态信息），或做出限制性的拓扑假设，例如将目标物体建模为三维球体。 我们提出了一种新的自监督方法，利用简单的先验即可学习拓扑结构复杂的物体类别的特征。 我们的方法不依赖昂贵的实例级生成分析流程，而是通过全局数据集层面的对比学习和分布匹配，来学习某一类别的大致形状和外观。 结合额外的几何损失函数，这种方法使我们能够复现与真实图像中提取的视觉特征相匹配的全局和局部统计特性。 我们在多个具有挑战性的物体类别上展示了定量结果，证明了该方法的有效性。
